summary: Review-required audit trail for the live memory-dump cleanup card. The app already ships this file-backed cleanup action and the repo cleanup docs describe the same dump paths, but the card has not yet been promoted into the validated research-provider surface.

setting.name: Clear Memory Dump Files
setting.casual_explanation: This deletes Windows crash-dump files such as MEMORY.DMP and minidumps.
setting.why_people_change_it: People clear crash dumps when they want to reclaim disk space after collecting the files they need for troubleshooting.
setting.tradeoffs_overview: Clearing the files reclaims space but also removes crash-dump artifacts that might be useful for later debugging.
setting.professional_notes: The current app deletes %WINDIR%\MEMORY.DMP when present and removes the %WINDIR%\Minidump directory contents. Repo cleanup docs identify the same memory-dump cleanup surface.

allowed_values.label: No cleanup action
allowed_values.meaning: Crash-dump files remain until the operator or Windows removes them.

allowed_values.label: Clear memory dump files
allowed_values.meaning: Deletes MEMORY.DMP and the Minidump directory tracked by the current app.
